# Aroha

> Aroha is a free self-care web app for young adults (18+) living with generalised anxiety. It is a companion, not a medical service: it does not diagnose, treat, or measure vital signs.

## What it does
- One-tap "How are you right now?" check-in (happy, calm, neutral, anxious, sad)
- Journal of mood, sleep, body symptoms and notes, with month and year views and weekly trends (no streaks)
- SOS sheet: guided breathing (in 4, out 6), 5-4-3-2-1 grounding, a one-tap text to trusted people, and region-aware crisis helplines (India Tele-MANAS 14416, US/Canada 988, UK/Ireland Samaritans 116 123, Australia Lifeline 13 11 14, New Zealand 1737)
- Safe box for happy memories, keepsake cards and voice notes
- To-dos that break tasks into small steps; unfinished tasks carry over
- Short reads: a 60-second panic plan, grounding, when to ask for help, sleep with a busy mind, self-compassion

## Design choices
- No heart-rate or temperature tracking: repeated body checking can feed anxiety.
- No account and no server. Data stays in the browser; users can download, restore or delete it.
- No tracking and no third-party requests.

## Audience
Adults aged 18 and over.
